cards.name: Camp Promise
cards.description: Barrier-free overnight camp for teens and adults with muscular dystrophy or select neuromuscular diseases. Campers participate in traditional camp activities adapted through technology, creativity, and special guests.

season.text: All Camp Promise dates and locations are subject to change.

prices.label: Free of charge to all campers

special_needs.text: Camp Promise accepts campers ages 13 years or older who have muscular dystrophy or another eligible neuromuscular disorder.

cards.review_notes: The 2027 program page names Marietta but not the venue. Camp Spearhead is carried from the provider's supplied Southeast history; confirm the 2027 venue before publishing the map. The venue operator publishes its location as Pleasant Ridge Camp & Retreat Center, 4232 Hwy 11, Marietta, SC. The camper FAQ still lists August 6–9 for the explicitly identified 2026 season on application pages; the main page explicitly lists August 12–15 under 2027.
